741700701.text: Huh. Was the time limit too short? It seems even you found that rather tricky...

741700702.text: Would you like to try again? You just need to <color=#00E1FFFF>retrieve all the anchors inside the building within the time limit</color>, and then come find me.

741700704.text: Alright then, I'll be timing you, as before.

741700706.text: Just being kicked out of the Fontaine Research Institute didn't bring him to his senses. He really is pigheaded.

741700707.text: But nobody is backing him now, so you can relax. He can't cause any more trouble.

741700709.text: I don't know either. I don't recall anyone by that name at the Fontaine Research Institute... Perhaps, as far as he's concerned, it's better that nobody by that name exists?

741700710.text: Just like he said himself, Kuisel was just a convenient character. The more different that character was from himself, the better, as it made it less likely anyone would recognize him... Although that's just a guess of mine.

741700711.text: *sigh* If you ask me, though, I think he changed enough over the years as it is. I didn't recognize him at first.

741700713.text: It's puzzling, isn't it? It seems like he's made... uh... various modifications to this place.

741700714.text: Now it feels more suited to some ancient ruins that tourists might visit... Although perhaps it isn't too prudent to say it like that.

741700715.text: *ahem* The aforementioned viewpoint is only my personal opinion, and is not representative of the Fontaine Research Institute or its viewpoints.

741700718.text: *sigh* This place starts to feel scary if you're alone here for too long...

741700208.text: Let me give it a try.

741700209.text: Alright. I'll time you. Don't forget, you need to <color=#00E1FFFF>retrieve all the anchors inside the building within the time limit</color>, and then come find me.

741700501.text: Alright, I'm timing you. You need to <color=#00E1FFFF>retrieve all the anchors inside the building within the time limit</color>, and then come find me.

741700401.text: You got it! Looks like this challenge isn't impossible, after all! Guess I can submit this proposal to the Institute!

741700402.text: Shame that I haven't finished checking all the assets yet, so I'll have to come back here later.

741700403.text: But regardless, thanks for your help! Ah yes, and here's your reward. Safe travels, now!

741700201.text: Oh, you're back. Well, and so am I...

741700202.text: After the Institute heard my brief report, I was asked to assess the area for suitability as a quality development training ground alongside conducting my retrieval work.

741700203.text: *sigh* This all feels very familiar, somehow. I remember that there was a period of time when our Administrative Officer was very big on getting everyone to do diving training as well.

741700204.text: I personally think that it's all rather pointless, but work is work, I suppose, and a mission is a mission... Not to mention how this place is rather strange... I mean, unique.

741700205.text: As such, I've placed a few replica anchors in the area. Don't worry, they're just dummies. They're one-hundred-percent safe.

741700206.text: The content of the current training is to <color=#00E1FFFF>retrieve all the anchors inside the building within the time limit</color>.

741700207.text: Would you like to give it a go? I can give you some compensation for taking part — you'll be assisting in research, after all.
